row.notes: Read in full. Returns for the null key (index 0, id 0x3fff). Without a career object ([[self+0x2a8]+0x88]+0x260) it checks Ent_Get_VehicleCustomisation(self+0x280, key), looks the key up in the bitmap set at self+0x1d8..+0x1e8 and calls Career_MyTeam_SyncDriverCustomisationsFromLivery([self+0x278], &key, &[self+0x1b4]). With one, it resolves the player team entry (0x88-byte records at career+0x2e0), requires a CareerComponent and that the vehicle resolved by 0x141401e00 equals vehicle_key, reads up to 5 items twice from vehicle customisation +0xe0 (0x1413fac80, selector [self+0x2b8]), copies the driver customisation (Wear_Get_DriverCustomisation, Wear_Copy_DriverCustomisationRecord), fills two arrays of five 0x28-byte slots (item id, 0xffffffff, index; unused slots get 0xffff0009 / 0xff000000) and stores it with Ent_EntrantsSystem_ReplaceDriverCustomisation. Caller 0x141108c40: after setting the frontend car decals it calls this, then Career_OwnerSetup_ApplySuit and the driver decal update; caller 0x142048480 calls it per loadout before updating driver decals.
